decisions.statement: Update the handbook to clarify that if the original purchaser is unavailable, written confirmation from an authorized company representative is required for contract resets, and make the Billing Account instructions clearer.
decisions.quote: we’ll update the handbook to clarify that if the original purchaser is unavailable, written confirmation from an authorized company rep is required. And we’ll make the Billing Account instructions clearer.

decisions.statement: A signed GitLab quote or order form is acceptable instead of a purchase order for booking, provided it includes signature, full name, title, and date, and meets the handbook's booking requirements.
decisions.quote: a signed GitLab quote or order form is fine instead of a PO, as long as it has the signature, full name, title, and date
decisions.where: #deal-desk: Hey, does anyone know where to find the Partner FAQ for Selling with G

decisions.statement: Auto-renewal is not enforced on partner deals; partners and customers are not obligated to renew without notice, and the company will confirm with the partner before suspending service if there is no renewal or notification.
decisions.quote: auto-renewal is not enforced on partner deals, partners and customers aren’t obligated to renew without notice, and we’ll confirm with the partner before suspending service if there’s no renewal or notification.
decisions.page: GitLab Sales FAQ - Selling with Partners

decisions.statement: The Initial Source for renewals will always reference the oldest Closed-Won, New Business opportunity on the account, not the linked source opportunity.
decisions.quote: The Initial Source for renewals will always reference the oldest Closed-Won, New Biz opp on the account, not the linked source opp.

decisions.statement: The Default Logic, Definitions, and Use Cases sections in the handbook will be updated to reflect the new renewal logic.
decisions.quote: we’re updating the Default Logic, Definitions, and Use Cases sections as discussed, including the new renewal logic.

decisions.statement: If there is no Closed-Won, New Business opportunity on the account, the Initial Source for renewals will default to 'Unknown'.
decisions.quote: I’d say we default to Unknown if there’s no Closed-Won, New Biz opp.

decisions.statement: Approve the new process language for both resale and referral deal registrations, including the ESM review section as drafted, with Nadia’s edits.
decisions.quote: we’re approving the new process language for both resale and referral deal registrations, and adding the ESM review section as drafted, with Nadia’s edits.

decisions.statement: For forecast calls, the 'RevOps Master Pipeline' dashboard in Tableau is the required source of truth for pipeline coverage.
decisions.quote: For the forecast call specifically, we always use the 'RevOps Master Pipeline' dashboard in Tableau.
